proposed_capability: Extend existing player-authored per-Sim task continuity with selected-Sim/off-screen quarantine and opt-in autonomy queue moderation. Distinguish positive whims (advisory candidates only) from independently classified harmful actions (single cancellation proposal only). Add a typed top-left Discovery Quest microsystem routing Scoring Simoleons/Navigating Needs to their existing catalog owners and treating You and Your Phone with observed phone affordances only; no new daemon or game-input authority.
player_save_control_impact: No game option mutation, actor-selection clicks, global autonomy override, direct queue cancellation, physical phone actions, downloads, calls, sends, buy actions, scheduled scans or user save edits. One proposal requires currently selected Sim, fresh queue/panel evidence, independent screen admission and reversible reviewed per-installation policy.
expected_outcome: For Tim and another Sim, stable target-by-target garden work is preserved while Tim is off-screen; after reselect, new observation is required before any resume. Verified harmful autonomous interaction may produce a single inspect/cancel proposal but never an actual cancellation or a player-authorized queue override. Whim suggestions only promote evidence-supported useful possibilities. Top-left quest routing composes existing scoring/needs catalogs and supplies an observed-available-only phone action candidate, never guessed pixels or quest goals.
negative_tests: An unselected Sim cannot trigger plan/click/cancel; preserve its open goal and require reselect/reobserve
Autonomy FULL/OFF/UNKNOWN is input not authority; setting not silently mutated
Human/player-directed queue entries never canceled, including harmful labels
Unverified autonomy provenance or negative effect evidence cannot authorize cancel proposal
Ordinary social interaction is not universally negative; beneficial whim cannot override urgent needs or established work
Only observed enabled exact phone affordance for current quest goal can be proposed
Panel mismatch, stale capture, unknown panel or invisible/unverified panel fail closed
Legacy gardening without new fields is unaffected; no duplicate batch queue
No two simultaneous cancellation candidates or blind retry; output never supplies input permit
rollback_path: Revert isolated branch; existing listener and in-game settings untouched.
unresolved_unknowns: How the actual installed Sims build preserves off-screen queues and displays action provenance and top-left goal evidence
Exact native queue cancellation adapter and hitbox calibration requires local game P08; not provided by source-only tests
